$description: Every piece a theme may redraw in sprites.json, by id: a grid of letters (≤ 16 × 16; '.' is empty), each letter a color.sprite token through the file's palette. Anything a theme leaves out keeps the built-in drawing (or line icon). Drawn at the size given, pixels stay crisp; a piece is scaled by whole pixels to fill its box (avatars their ring, medals 32 px). The five avatars are the pictures people pick; "Initials" stays letters in every theme.
